items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: Nolly's Hoe (+1 Striking Anarchic Halfling Sling Staff)
items.description: This staff ends in a Y-shaped split that cradles a sling. The length of the staff provides excellent leverage when used two-handed to fling rocks or bullets from the sling.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator)
items.description:
You need thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Pick a Lock]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Disable a Device]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill. Infiltrator thieves' tools add a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Thieves' Toolkit (Infiltrator Picks)]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action. If you wear your thieves' tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

defensiveAbilities.name: Halfling Luck
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Nolly fails a skill check or a saving throw.

Effect Nolly rerolls the triggering check, but she must use the new result, even if it's worse.

defensiveAbilities.name: Inspiring Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
30 feet. Allies within 30 feet of Nolly gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against fear effects.

Effect: Inspiring Presence

offensiveAbilities.name: Designate Bellflower Crop
offensiveAbilities.description:
Nolly designates an ally within 30 feet as a member of her Bellflower crop. Nolly can have up to 10 members in her crop at once; any member added in excess of this number automatically removes a crop member of Nolly's choice. When Nolly or a member of her crop Aids a crop member and rolls a success, they get a critical success to Aid instead.

When a crop member within 60 feet of Nolly fails a saving throw against an effect that would impose the Confused or Paralyzed condition, the crop member can use a reaction to reroll the saving throw and use the better of the two results. This is a fortune effect.

offensiveAbilities.name: Liberating Trick
offensiveAbilities.description: Nolly frees herself or a creature within her reach from the Grabbed condition.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Movements
offensiveAbilities.description: Nolly doesn't trigger reactions with her movement or with any use of the Thievery skill.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Nolly deals an extra 3d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
